Q6095.reason: Lactate and H+ exit muscle mainly by facilitated transport through monocarboxylate transporter proteins (MCT), not simple diffusion, active pumping, or carnosine.

Q6097.reason: In most states, 'and the heirs of his body' no longer creates a fee tail and instead gives the cousin a fee simple absolute, so the later deed to the niece conveys nothing.

Q6098.reason: Custom shutters screwed into the window frames were annexed and adapted to the house, so they were fixtures that passed with the realty even though the contract never mentioned them.
